column1: # One `section<TAB>line` row per numbered section of the published protocol
# specification -- headings AND ordered-list items, because that document numbers
# several of its sections as lists and a heading-only index reports their points
# as dangling. This repository does not ship that document, so the numbers are
# vendored here for `bin/check-publication-paths` to resolve citations against
# offline. When both repositories are checked out side by side the same script
# re-derives them and fails on any disagreement, so the copy cannot drift.
